entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I ordered a jersey and it's completely the wrong size! This is unbelievable. Your sizing chart is a total lie. It's way too tight and I can barely get it on.
I'm very sorry to hear that the fit wasn't right. I can definitely help you with this. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
The name is Mike Sterling, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. I expect this to be fixed immediately. I've spent thousands of dollars with you people. This is the worst service I've ever had.
Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered 12 days ago. I also see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty.
If you appreciated it, you'd send me clothes that actually fit! What are you going to do about this? I want to return it. Or better yet, get me a manager.

That won't be necessary, sir. I can resolve this for you right now. You are well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process an exchange for a larger size or issue a full refund. Which would you prefer?
Finally! I want an exchange. But this whole experience has been a massive waste of my time. I'm half-tempted to just leave a one-star review and be done with VeloFit for good.

I completely understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience with the jersey sizing. I have already initiated the exchange for one size up. To make things right, I've upgraded the shipping on the new one to complimentary overnight, so you'll have it tomorrow. I've also added a $50 store credit to your account for you to use on a future purchase.
Overnight shipping and a fifty dollar credit? ...Okay. That's... acceptable. Fine. Just make sure the exchange is processed correctly this time.

Of course. I've just confirmed it. Your new jersey will ship out today. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label for the one that's too tight. You can just drop that in the mail at your convenience. Is there anything else I can assist you with, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's all. Just get it right.
It's all taken care of. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
